newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bonds unleashed, 116-00 next stop up.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bonds unleashed, 116-00 next stop up.

text.p: U.S. T-bond futures will aim for the round number at 116-00 on Wednesday, full of enthusiasm after a speech from Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan on Tuesday, analysts said.
"Technically this market is in great shape. Fundamentally it is in tremendous shape," Bill Westgate, vice-president at HSBC Futures in London. "You've got to get long and stay long."

T-bond futures were at 115-12 at 0946 GMT, up 4/32 in automated trade, after touching 115-20 earlier. That high would be the market's first point of contact on the upside during pit trading this session, analysts said.
It also roughly corresponds to a trendline connecting the May 21 and middle of June highs and the 115-17 high for the September contract on December 3.
"There's quite decent resistance around the 115-20 level," said Jim Dodgin, technical analyst at Technical Data here.
Above there, there was little to hold the market back until the psychological 116-00 level. Weekly continuation charts then offered resistance at 116-28 from December 6.
Greenspan said in his Humphrey-Hawkins testimony that the Fed would raise U.S. interest rates if needed to head off inflation but suggested it might not happen soon.
He also suggested the economy might be undergoing some "basic improvements" thanks to technological advances that were boosting worker productivity and corporate profits.

"This guy is a member of a very conservative institution," Westgate said. "He can't go out there talking about revolutionary changes. He has to be very subtle but he said the words and that's why the market rallied."
Analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell saw support at 115-02.
That was the high from July 17 and also the top of the first wave higher from a 113-07 low on July 15 in a current five-wave Elliott Wave advance. The third wave target was 115-22.
Below there, analysts saw support at the July 16 high of 114-27.
At the short end, December Eurodollars were quoted at 94.125 up 0.010.
